title: A confirm card names the record Tracy read, says yes/no and the call's own verb in the conversation's language, and is never shown in the door's English to another language; writes carry the record's title
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the run.cmd below.
S2: Read the exit code and the pass/fail counts.
expect: untranslatedConfirmCard(confirmQuestion(key, sentence), 'Vietnamese') names the question id as still in English and asks for Vietnamese; the same card with a Vietnamese question and options passes; 'English' and '' pass; a question whose id does not start with confirm- passes.

site-call: a delete asks 'This deletes "<title>" from your site.' with the title read by content.get; an unreadable record answers TARGET_UNREAD and nothing is deleted; a hide card saying delete, or swapped buttons, is refused in Vietnamese.
emdash: content_unpublish asks with the entry's title read by content_get; an unreadable entry answers TARGET_UNREAD.
handler: a write's Apply call carries x-tracy-write-title only with the title read for the same kind and id; a read carries none.
evidence: Local stand 20/10/2026: EmDash dskeepem typed request got 'This takes one of your posts off your site's pages. Go ahead?'; Joomla dsl4mo by Voice got 'This deletes something from your site.' read aloud, the spoken 'Dong y' matched no option (screens in ~/tracy-bench-work/voice-mode/runs-1480).
fence: The card check as a pure function over the door's own ask. Not exercised: a model choosing to reword, the live page.
